title: Easy Mushroom 'Meat' Ragu
subtitle: with Fluffy Mashed Potato and Peas
description: There's something about comfort food that just soothes the soul – and keeps bellies happy too! We've simmered mushroom 'meat' with tomato and herbs, then piled it onto a mound of moreish mash.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Finely chop the onion. Peel the potatoes and cut into 2cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves.

Make mash: Put the potato in a medium saucepan of cold salted water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 10 mins or until tender. Drain and return to the pan. Mash the potato until smooth. Add 20g butter (see Make it yours), season with salt and pepper and stir until combined. Cover to keep warm.

Start ragu: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion and garlic, stirring occasionally, for 4 mins or until softened. Increase the heat to high, add the mushroom meat and cook, breaking up the lumps with a spoon, for 2 mins or until starting to brown. Add 1½ tbs water and cook, stirring, for a further 3 mins or until browned.

Simmer ragu: Add the mint and rosemary seasoning and 2 tbs tomato paste to the mushroom mixture and cook, stirring, for 30 secs. Add the tomatoes and 180ml (¾ cup) water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 mins until slightly thickened. Remove the pan from the heat.

Serve up: Meanwhile, bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the peas. Cook the peas in the pan of boiling water for 2 mins or until tender, then drain. Taste the ragu, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the mashed potato, ragu and peas among bowls and enjoy!
Make it yours: If you prefer, replace the butter in the mashed potato with a dairy-free alternative or olive oil.
